title: One-Third
paragraphs: “Seeing Motoyasu-kun’s skill like that, it really makes you want to say ‘Fire—’ doesn’t it?”
“More otaku knowledge again…? Well, I do remember a similar ability. There was an esper who could control flames.”

As I finished off the Crimson Swine, sunlight began to break through the sky. Then, the souls that had been gathered within the Crimson Swine were released from their restraints and scattered. Well, as long as there are survivors, that’s what matters. This should slightly reduce the number of victims, right?
“Now then, I will purify the land with the power of my staff. Heroes… please bring reinforcements from Faubrey and assist us.”
It seems the Queen is already diving straight into the restoration efforts. What a swift change of pace.
“Sister… even in death, you remain a pitiful person.”
“Princess Malty… just how foolish and selfish could you possibly be? You were the complete opposite of what a true ruler should be.”

Éclair looks completely exasperated, standing there in stunned silence. That Crimson Swine was nothing but a menace, whether alive or dead! If there’s a next time, I’ll make sure to erase even its soul.
“Well… I have to say, I was really shocked when she just showed up out of nowhere acting like some kind of final boss.”
“Seriously though, what was the point of her life?”
“Exactly. One moment, she’s getting off on watching people suffer after trapping them, and the next, she’s obsessed with power. She never seemed like the type to put in any real effort either.”

The feeling of exhaustion far outweighs any sense of accomplishment. Out of all the battles so far, this one left me with the most frustration. I feel refreshed, but Father and the others look uneasy. Well, I suppose the number of casualties must be quite high.
“There are a lot of women like that in the Dragon Emperor’s memories! Even among that whip guy’s group, there were some pretty similar ones!”

“Takt will go for any woman, won’t he? Well, as long as he’s still getting beaten down by the Pig King, I guess it’s fine… but what if he turns into an evil spirit like her? Wouldn’t that be dangerous? What if he offs himself or something? That kind of thing happens in stories about palace intrigue, right?”
“That won’t be a problem. While it’s different from the Soul Eater, Faubrey’s castle has been raising a monster called a Soul Vacuum.”
“It’s probably best not to ask why they have a creature like that.”
“It’s probably used for sorcery or something? It seems like it would work against dog-god curses and the like.”
“I mean, their king was the type to send AVs to his prospective in-laws… he must have had a lot of enemies.”
And so, while chatting, we returned to Faubrey to assist with the restoration efforts.

After that, what we did was send religious representatives, soldiers, knights, and even medical personnel from Faubrey to Melromarc. First, regarding Melromarc’s damage—among the citizens in the castle town, only one in five survived. Even among those survivors, most were severely weakened, and recovery would take a long time. As for the rest, not only had their magic been drained, but even their very souls had been sucked away, leading to unnatural deaths. Many of the corpses had even turned into undead. With Melromarc now resembling a demon-infested ruin, dealing with the aftermath would be a massive undertaking. Apparently, the castle town had been contaminated just the day before we arrived. The soldiers inside Melromarc Castle were reportedly almost entirely wiped out. As for the Three Heroes Church followers inside the castle, most of them had dried up and died due to the Crimson Swine and the new pope. Now, regarding how far the ritual’s range actually expanded—it spread from the center of Melromarc Castle to cover nearly a third of Melromarc’s territory. An incredible speed. It expanded exactly as far as the name of their own religion suggested, spreading devastation along with it. Well, the Three Heroes Church followers who were extending that range apparently perished at the same time the spectral Crimson Swine was defeated. Because of that, the situation had already shifted into disaster relief, and at the same time, the problems caused by the Three Heroes Church had spread across the entire country. Of course, those who noticed early on that something was wrong in the castle town and fled before we arrived managed to escape unharmed. And then… regarding the faction that supported the Queen within Melromarc. More than half of them had been imprisoned in the castle and perished, but those who weren’t had been exiled to the remote regions of Melromarc and were thus spared. The same applied to the soldiers—those who had doubts about the Three Heroes Church or couldn’t be punished due to insufficient justification had also been relocated. And then… as those who had lost their beloved families began to question the Three Heroes Church, and as the heroes shattered their ambitions, the result was…

Thanks to the Queen revealing the truth, the Three Heroes Church was branded as a heretical cult on a global scale, to the point where even calling oneself a follower became taboo. Currently, the purification of Melromarc’s castle town is being carried out by the Four Heroes Church members we summoned. The number of victims has reportedly become enormous. The Queen invited us for lunch and explained the situation.
“The damage is staggering.”
“It’s beyond words.”
“Yeah… this is just too much…”
“Including this recent incident, estimates suggest that the Three Heroes Church is responsible for the deaths of one-third of Melromarc’s population.”
“At this point, it’s nothing but a completely evil cult that stands against the entire world,” Ren muttered in half-disbelief.
That was exactly right.
“Reconstruction will take time, and other nations may see this as an opportunity to invade, but…”
The Queen is gazing at the staff she now possesses. At this point, the Queen is the Staff Hero.

Now, let’s talk about the official incident report that has been circulated. It seems that Trash, like the Queen, had placed a body double in the castle and was wandering other countries. When he opposed the Three Heroes Church’s rampage, he rushed back and fought against them. However, he fell just short of victory and collapsed before the Four Holy Heroes and the Queen, entrusting everything to her before passing away.

The title of “Wise King of Wisdom” carries a heavy weight, and apparently, without this version of events, there would have been diplomatic issues. The Queen was concerned that simply being chosen by the Staff Vassal Weapon would not be enough to deter invasions.
“Well, as long as Her Majesty is reigning as the Staff Hero, there shouldn’t be… a problem, right?”

“If anyone tries to recklessly start a war, they’ll just be struck down. And Faubrey is already spreading the word that the heroes have delivered judgment, aren’t they?” Father responded, and Ren explained Faubrey’s stance.
That was indeed the case.
“It’s been a lot of grim talk, but since that troublesome religion, the Three Heroes Church, has been wiped out, shouldn’t we consider this a net positive?”
“That’s true, but… I can’t help but think there could have been a better way to resolve this.”

Father subtly glanced in my direction. So I responded with a wink. That made him look slightly exasperated. Well, this was an incredibly unexpected event. Something like this had never happened before. However…
“Father, this was basically all my fault!”
“…The very words everyone was avoiding, and he just came out and said it!?”
“Haah… I wasn’t planning on pressing the issue since even Motoyasu isn’t a god, but… do you understand what exactly went wrong?”
“Up to the point of earning everyone’s trust, things were going well. Do you realize where it went bad after that?”
“Come on now… there was no way anyone could’ve predicted things would escalate this far.”
Oh! Father is defending me! I am so moved that tears are welling up!
“…Are you actually reflecting on this?”
“Who knows? If it’s something Naofumi said, I feel like he’d just salute and do whatever without question, and that’s terrifying.”
Itsuki and Ren crossed their arms and gave me skeptical looks. How rude. I do reflect on my actions. Of course, if I think it’s necessary, I’ll do what needs to be done.
“Yes, that’s right. If Kitamura-dono is truly repeating the same time over and over, then please, avoid making the decision to kill Aultcray…”
I heard the Queen’s words, which sounded almost like a prayer. Indeed. If it would lead to an incident like this, I suppose I’ll settle for leaving Trash half-dead.
“Understood! Then I’ll erase the Crimson Swine’s soul completely and spare Trash!”
“That’s the part you won’t budge on, huh?”
“Well, considering she tried to take over the country even after becoming a ghost…”
“Given what’s happened so far, that might actually be the better choice.”
This time, I won’t just kill recklessly. I’ll think things through before finishing the job.
